SELECT s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno County Office of Education'

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Charter = 1
  AND s.County = 'Fresno'
  AND s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT Zip
FROM schools
WHERE Charter = 1
  AND County = 'Fresno'
  AND DOCType = 'County Office of Education (COE)'

FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno'
  AND s.DOCType = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1;

FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools s ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode

FROM satscores ss

FROM schools s

SELECT CharterNum
FROM schools
WHERE CharterNum IS NOT NULL
  AND CDSCode IN (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE AvgScrWrite > 499
  )
ORDER BY (
    SELECT AvgScrWrite
    FROM satscores
    WHERE satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
  ) DESC;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street || 
    CASE WHEN s.StreetAbr IS NOT NULL AND s.StreetAbr != '' THEN ' ' || s.StreetAbr ELSE '' END || ', ' ||
    s.City || ', ' || 
    s.State || ' ' || 
    s.Zip AS Full_Address
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`High Grade` >= '9' -- to ensure high school level
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND f.`High Grade` >= '12'
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND f.`High Grade` >= '9'
  AND f.`Low Grade` <= '12'
  AND f.`School Type` LIKE '%High%'

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street || CASE WHEN s.StreetAbr IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || s.StreetAbr ELSE '' END || ', ' ||
    s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip AS Full_Address
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`High Grade` >= '9' 
  AND f.`Low Grade` <= '12'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip AS FullAddress
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.County = 'Monterey'
    AND f.`High Grade` >= '9'
    AND f.`Low Grade` <= '12'
    AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800

SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    TRIM(
        COALESCE(s.Street, '') || ', ' || 
        COALESCE(s.City, '') || ', ' || 
        COALESCE(s.State, '') || ' ' || 
        COALESCE(s.Zip, '')
    ) AS FullAddress
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.County = 'Monterey'
    AND f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
    AND (
        f.`Low Grade` <= '9' AND f.`High Grade` >= '12'
        OR f.`Low Grade` <= '10' AND f.`High Grade` >= '12'
        OR f.`Low Grade` <= '11' AND f.`High Grade` >= '12'
        OR f.`Low Grade` <= '12' AND f.`High Grade` >= '12'
    )
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.SOC IN ('66', '67') -- High Schools (Public) and High Schools in 1 School District (Public)
;

SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS AvgWritingScore,
    s.Phone AS CommunicationNumber
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE 
    (s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR (s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL AND s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'))
    AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL;

SELECT

FROM

JOIN

WHERE 
    (sch.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR (sch.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL AND sch.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'))
    AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL;

SELECT

    (sc.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR (sc.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL AND sc.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'))

SELECT School AS City, `Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE `Low Grade` <= '1' AND `High Grade` >= '12' AND `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT City
FROM schools
ORDER BY (
    SELECT SUM(enroll12)
    FROM satscores
    WHERE satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT City
FROM schools
ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(GSserved, '') AS TEXT) LIKE '1-12' DESC, 
         CASE 
           WHEN GSserved = '1-12' THEN 0
           ELSE 1
         END,
         (SELECT SUM(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`) 
          FROM frpm 
          WHERE frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT City
FROM schools
ORDER BY 
  (SELECT SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") 
   FROM frpm 
   WHERE frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `Low Grade` <= '1' AND `High Grade` >= '11'
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 10 OFFSET 9;

SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.rtype = 'School'
ORDER BY satscores.enroll12 DESC
LIMIT 11 OFFSET 9;

SELECT `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT `School Name`, 
       CASE 
         WHEN `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 THEN `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`
         ELSE NULL
       END AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT frpm.`School Name`, frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Low Grade` <= '1'
  AND frpm.`High Grade` >= '12'
  AND schools.DOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`

  AND frpm.`Low Grade` <= '1'

SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`

WHERE schools.SOC = 66
  AND frpm.`Low Grade` = '1'
  AND frpm.`High Grade` = '12'

SELECT 
    frpm.`School Name`,
    frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Eligible_FRPM_Rate
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    schools.SOC = 66
    AND frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0

SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` AS Free_Rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE (schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (schools.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
   OR (schools.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson')
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` AS Free_Rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE (schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' OR schools.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey')
  AND (schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson' OR schools.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0 THEN frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Free_Rate_5_17
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' 
    AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'
LIMIT 1;

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.County,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rank_in_county
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'Yes' AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School
FROM RankedSchools
WHERE rank_in_county <= 5;

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.County,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rank_in_county
    FROM
        schools s
    JOIN
        satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE
        s.Virtual = 'Yes' OR s.Virtual = 'yes' OR s.Virtual = 'Y' OR s.Virtual = 'y'
        AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    School
FROM
    RankedSchools
WHERE
    rank_in_county <= 5
ORDER BY
    County,
    rank_in_county;

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        s.County,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        s.Virtual,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC) AS RankInCounty
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE s.Virtual IN ('F', 'V') AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School
FROM RankedSchools
WHERE RankInCounty <= 5
ORDER BY County, RankInCounty;

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.County,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rank_in_county
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
)
SELECT School
FROM RankedSchools
WHERE rank_in_county <= 5
ORDER BY County, rank_in_county;

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'State Special School'
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 'State Special Schools'

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.Enrollment
FROM (
    SELECT frpm.CDSCode, frpm.`School Name` AS School, frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment
    FROM frpm
    JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE schools.DOC = '31' AND frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
) s
WHERE s.Enrollment = (
    SELECT MAX(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
    FROM frpm
    JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE schools.DOC = '31' AND frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31' 
  AND frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.DistrictType = 'Unified School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.DistrictType = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        frpm.`District Code`, 
        frpm.`District Type`
    FROM frpm
    WHERE frpm.`County Name` = 'Orange'
) s;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.DistrictType = 'Unified School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.DistrictType = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        frpm.`District Code`, 
        frpm.`District Name`, 
        frpm.`County Name`, 
        frpm.`District Type`
    FROM frpm
    WHERE frpm.`County Name` = 'Orange'
) s;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Merged' AND s.DOCType = 'Unified School District' AND s.County = 'Orange' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Merged' AND s.DOCType = 'Elementary School District' AND s.County = 'Orange' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio_merged_unified_to_elementary
FROM schools s;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS merged_unified_to_elementary_ratio
FROM schools s
WHERE s.County = 'Orange' AND s.StatusType = 'Merged';

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.FundingType = 'Local' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.FundingType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2
    ) AS Local_Funded_Percentage,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.FundingType != 'Local' AND s.FundingType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.FundingType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2
    ) AS Other_Funded_Percentage
FROM schools s
WHERE s.County = 'Santa Clara' AND s.Charter = 1 AND s.FundingType IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 AND s.FundingType = 'Local' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 AND s.FundingType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2
    ) AS Local_Funding_Percentage
FROM schools s
WHERE s.County = 'Santa Clara';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
             SUM(CASE WHEN FundingType != 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    END AS ratio_percentage
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Santa Clara' AND Charter = 1 AND FundingType IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN FundingType = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS RatioPercentage
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Santa Clara' AND Charter = 1;

FROM

WHERE 
    County = 'Alpine'

WITH K8_MagnetSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.CDSCode,
        s.City,
        s.GSserved,
        COUNT(DISTINCT frpm.`NSLP Provision Status`) AS ProvisionTypeCount
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Magnet = 1
      AND (
        -- GSserved covers Kindergarten (K) to 8th grade
        -- GSserved format examples: 'K-8', 'K-6', 'K-7', 'K-8', '1-8', 'P-8', etc.
        -- We consider Kindergarten as 'K' or 'P' (preschool) or 'K' only, but problem states Kindergarten to 8th grade
        -- So we check if GSserved starts with 'K' or 'P' or 'K' and ends with 8 or higher
        -- To be safe, we parse GSserved to check if it includes K and 8
        -- Since GSserved is text, we check if it contains 'K' or 'P' at start and ends with 8 or higher
        -- We'll consider GSserved like 'K-8', 'K-7', 'K-6' etc. Only those ending with 8 or higher qualify
        -- We'll parse the high grade from GSserved
        -- Extract low and high grade from GSserved
        -- Low grade: substring before '-'
        -- High grade: substring after '-'
        -- If no '-', then GSserved is a single grade
        -- We consider only those with low grade K or P and high grade >= 8
        (
            (substr(s.GSserved, 1, 1) IN ('K', 'P'))
            AND (
                CASE 
                    WHEN instr(s.GSserved, '-') > 0 THEN 
                        CAST(substr(s.GSserved, instr(s.GSserved, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER)
                    ELSE 
                        CASE 
                            WHEN s.GSserved IN ('K', 'P') THEN 0
                            ELSE CAST(s.GSserved AS INTEGER)
                        END
                END
            ) >= 8
        )
    )
    GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.City, s.GSserved
),
MultipleProvisionCities AS (
    SELECT 
        City,
        COUNT(*) AS SchoolsWithMultipleProvision
    FROM K8_MagnetSchools
    WHERE ProvisionTypeCount > 1
    GROUP BY City
),
K8CitiesSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        City,
        COUNT(*) AS SchoolsServingK8
    FROM schools
    WHERE 
        (
            (substr(GSserved, 1, 1) IN ('K', 'P'))
            AND (
                CASE 
                    WHEN instr(GSserved, '-') > 0 THEN 
                        CAST(substr(GSserved, instr(GSserved, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER)
                    ELSE 
                        CASE 
                            WHEN GSserved IN ('K', 'P') THEN 0
                            ELSE CAST(GSserved AS INTEGER)
                        END
                END
            ) >= 8
        )
    GROUP BY City
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM K8_MagnetSchools WHERE ProvisionTypeCount > 1) AS NumMagnetSchoolsMultipleProvision,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT City) FROM K8CitiesSchools) AS NumCitiesOfferingK8,

FROM K8CitiesSchools
ORDER BY City;

       END AS artist_status,
       CASE 
         WHEN c.text IS NULL OR c.text = '' THEN 'Missing card text'
         ELSE 'Card text OK'

         WHEN r.text IS NULL OR r.text = '' THEN 'Missing ruling text'

WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniel';

SELECT 
    c.name,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(fd.uuid) / 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE uuid = c.uuid), 2
    ) AS percentage_spanish
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid AND fd.language = 'Spanish'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY percentage_spanish DESC;

SELECT 
    c.name,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT f.uuid) / 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE name = c.name), 2
    ) AS percentage_in_spanish
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid AND f.language = 'Spanish'
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING percentage_in_spanish > 0
ORDER BY percentage_in_spanish DESC;

SELECT 
    c.name,
    ROUND(
        (CAST(COUNT(fd.uuid) AS FLOAT) / 
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards)) * 100, 2
    ) AS percentage_in_spanish
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid AND fd.language = 'Spanish'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT

WITH banned_counts AS (
    SELECT format, COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS banned_count
    FROM legalities
    WHERE status = 'banned'
    GROUP BY format
),
max_banned_format AS (
    SELECT format
    FROM banned_counts
    WHERE banned_count = (SELECT MAX(banned_count) FROM banned_counts)
)
SELECT l.format, c.name
FROM legalities l
JOIN cards c ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'banned' AND l.format IN (SELECT format FROM max_banned_format)
ORDER BY l.format, c.name;

    SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS banned_count
    FROM legalities

    GROUP BY format
),
max_banned_format AS (

WITH MostInfluentialUser AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    ORDER BY Reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
UserPosts AS (
    SELECT Score
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM MostInfluentialUser)
),
CountPosts AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS TotalPosts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HighScorePosts
    FROM UserPosts
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN TotalPosts = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (HighScorePosts * 100.0) / TotalPosts
    END AS PercentageHighScorePosts
FROM CountPosts;

WITH InfluentialUser AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    ORDER BY Reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
UserPosts AS (
    SELECT Score
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM InfluentialUser)
),
TotalPosts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM UserPosts
),
HighScorePosts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_score_count FROM UserPosts WHERE Score > 50
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (high_score_count * 100.0) / total
    END AS percentage_above_50
FROM TotalPosts, HighScorePosts;

WITH CommentUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UserId
    FROM comments
    WHERE Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND UserId IS NOT NULL
),
UsersWithZeroUpVotes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.Id
    FROM users u
    JOIN CommentUsers cu ON u.Id = cu.UserId
    WHERE IFNULL(u.UpVotes, 0) = 0
),
TotalUsers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM CommentUsers
),
ZeroUpVoteUsers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_up FROM UsersWithZeroUpVotes
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (zero_up * 100.0) / total
    END AS percentage_zero_upvotes
FROM TotalUsers, ZeroUpVoteUsers;

WITH FilteredComments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UserId
    FROM comments
    WHERE Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND UserId IS NOT NULL
),
UsersWithZeroUpVotes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UserId
    FROM users
    WHERE UpVotes = 0
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT fc.UserId) FILTER (WHERE u.Id IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(DISTINCT fc.UserId), 
        2
    ) AS PercentageUsersWithZeroUpVotes
FROM FilteredComments fc
LEFT JOIN UsersWithZeroUpVotes u ON fc.UserId = u.UserId;

WITH filtered_comments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UserId
    FROM comments
    WHERE Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND UserId IS NOT NULL
),
users_with_zero_upvotes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.UserId
    FROM filtered_comments c
    JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.UpVotes = 0
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(fc.UserId) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(uz.UserId) / COUNT(fc.UserId), 2)
    END AS percentage_zero_upvotes
FROM filtered_comments fc
LEFT JOIN users_with_zero_upvotes uz ON fc.UserId = uz.UserId;

WITH RankedRaces AS (
    SELECT
        r.raceId,
        r.name,
        r.date,
        r.round,
        r.year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.raceId) AS race_rank
    FROM races r
),
PaulResults AS (
    SELECT
        res.raceId,
        res.fastestLapSpeed
    FROM results res
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
),
TargetRace AS (
    SELECT rr.raceId, rr.race_rank
    FROM RankedRaces rr
    JOIN PaulResults pr ON rr.raceId = pr.raceId
    WHERE rr.race_rank = 853
),
NextRace AS (
    SELECT rr.raceId, rr.race_rank
    FROM RankedRaces rr
    JOIN TargetRace tr ON rr.race_rank = tr.race_rank + 1
),
Speeds AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(pr1.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) AS speed_853,
        CAST(pr2.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) AS speed_next
    FROM PaulResults pr1
    JOIN TargetRace tr ON pr1.raceId = tr.raceId
    JOIN PaulResults pr2 ON pr2.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM NextRace)
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN speed_next = 0 OR speed_next IS NULL OR speed_853 IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE ((speed_853 - speed_next) / speed_next) * 100
    END AS percent_faster
FROM Speeds;

WITH Race853 AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.fastestLapSpeed, r.driverId
    FROM results r
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta' AND r.number = 853
    ORDER BY r.raceId
    LIMIT 1
),
NextRace AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.fastestLapSpeed
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.raceId > (SELECT raceId FROM Race853)
    ORDER BY r.raceId
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        ((CAST((SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM Race853) AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM NextRace) AS REAL)) 
        / CAST((SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM NextRace) AS REAL)) * 100, 2
    ) AS percent_faster
;

WITH race_853_fastest AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, r.fastestLapSpeed
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.raceId = 853
      AND r.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Paul' AND surname = 'di Resta')
),
next_race_fastest AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, r.fastestLapSpeed
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.raceId = 854
    ORDER BY r.fastestLapSpeed DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
paul_853_speed AS (
    SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM race_853_fastest
),
next_speed AS (
    SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM next_race_fastest
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN next_speed.fastestLapSpeed IS NULL OR paul_853_speed.fastestLapSpeed IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE ((paul_853_speed.fastestLapSpeed - next_speed.fastestLapSpeed) / next_speed.fastestLapSpeed) * 100
    END AS percent_faster
FROM paul_853_speed, next_speed;

SELECT 
    ((r1.fastestLapSpeed - r2.fastestLapSpeed) * 100.0) / r2.fastestLapSpeed AS percent_faster
FROM

JOIN

WHERE

ORDER BY

SELECT AVG(
    (CAST(substr(fastestLapTime, 1, instr(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS FLOAT) * 60) +
    CAST(substr(fastestLapTime, instr(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS FLOAT)
) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds
FROM results
JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton' AND fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND fastestLapTime != ''

SELECT AVG(
    CAST(
        SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, 
            CASE 
                WHEN INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') > 0 THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END + 1,
            CASE 
                WHEN INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') > 0 THEN INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1
                ELSE INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') - 1
            END
        ) AS REAL
    ) + 
    CASE 
        WHEN INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') > 0 THEN 
            CAST(SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
        ELSE 0
    END
) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds
FROM results
JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton' AND fastestLapTime != '' AND fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL;

WITH ParsedTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.fastestLapTime,
        r.driverId,
        -- Convert MM:SS.mmm to total seconds as real number
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.fastestLapTime, INSTR(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS fastestLapSeconds
    FROM results r
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.fastestLapTime != ''
)
SELECT AVG(fastestLapSeconds) AS average_fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM ParsedTimes;

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverId) * 1.0 / 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId)
     FROM drivers d
     JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
     JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
     WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
       AND d.dob < '1985-01-01') AS percentage
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON lt.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
  AND d.dob < '1985-01-01'
  AND lt.lap > 50;

WITH filtered_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lt.driverId
    FROM lapTimes lt
    JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
      AND d.dob < '1985-01-01'
      AND lt.lap > 50
),
all_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
    JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
      AND d.dob < '1985-01-01'
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN COUNT(all_drivers.driverId) = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(filtered_laps.driverId) / COUNT(all_drivers.driverId), 2)
    END AS percentage
FROM all_drivers
LEFT JOIN filtered_laps ON all_drivers.driverId = filtered_laps.driverId;

WITH filtered_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lt.driverId, lt.raceId
    FROM lapTimes lt

SELECT 
    ABS(
        (SELECT AVG(ball_control) 
         FROM Player_Attributes 
         WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'))
      - 
        (SELECT AVG(ball_control) 
         FROM Player_Attributes 
         WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye'))
    ) AS difference_average_ball_control;

WITH avg_ball_control AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        AVG(pa.ball_control) AS avg_ball_control
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye')
    GROUP BY p.player_name
)
SELECT 
    ABS(
        MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN avg_ball_control END) - 
        MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN avg_ball_control END)
    ) AS difference_avg_ball_control
FROM avg_ball_control;

WITH AbdouBallControl AS (
    SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control) AS avg_ball_control
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'
),
AaronBallControl AS (
    SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control) AS avg_ball_control
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye'
)
SELECT 
    ABS(AbdouBallControl.avg_ball_control - AaronBallControl.avg_ball_control) AS difference
FROM AbdouBallControl, AaronBallControl;

SELECT

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_api_id) AS count_players_remain_in_position
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id,
           MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
    GROUP BY player_api_id
) latest_pa ON pa.player_api_id = latest_pa.player_api_id AND pa.date = latest_pa.max_date
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND pa.positioning >= 50;

WITH 
LandonRating AS (
    SELECT pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date <= '2013-07-12'
    ORDER BY pa.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
JordanRating AS (
    SELECT pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND pa.date <= '2013-07-12'
    ORDER BY pa.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN JordanRating.overall_rating = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((LandonRating.overall_rating - JordanRating.overall_rating) * 100.0 / JordanRating.overall_rating)
    END AS percentage_higher
FROM LandonRating, JordanRating;

LandonRating AS (
    SELECT overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date <= '2013-07-12'

),
JordanRating AS (
    SELECT overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND pa.date <= '2013-07-12'
    ORDER BY pa.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN JordanRating.overall_rating = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((LandonRating.overall_rating - JordanRating.overall_rating) * 100.0 / JordanRating.overall_rating)
    END AS percentage_higher
FROM LandonRating, JordanRating;

WITH 
Landon AS (
    SELECT overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND date <= '2013-07-12'
    ORDER BY date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
Jordan AS (
    SELECT overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND date <= '2013-07-12'
    ORDER BY date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN Jordan.overall_rating = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((Landon.overall_rating - Jordan.overall_rating) * 100.0 / Jordan.overall_rating)
    END AS percentage_higher
FROM Landon, Jordan;

WITH ld_rating AS (
    SELECT overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND date <= '2013-07-12'
    ORDER BY date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
jb_rating AS (
    SELECT overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND date <= '2013-07-12'
    ORDER BY date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (ld_rating.overall_rating - jb_rating.overall_rating) * 100.0 / ld_rating.overall_rating,
        2
    ) AS percentage_higher
FROM ld_rating, jb_rating;

WITH MalePatients AS (
    SELECT ID, Admission
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'male'
),
Counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = 'in-patient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS InPatientCount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = 'outpatient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OutPatientCount
    FROM MalePatients
),
Comparison AS (
    SELECT
        InPatientCount,
        OutPatientCount,
        CASE
            WHEN InPatientCount > OutPatientCount THEN 'in-patient'
            WHEN OutPatientCount > InPatientCount THEN 'outpatient'
            ELSE 'equal'
        END AS MoreGroup,
        CASE
            WHEN InPatientCount > OutPatientCount THEN ((InPatientCount - OutPatientCount) * 100.0) / OutPatientCount
            WHEN OutPatientCount > InPatientCount THEN ((OutPatientCount - InPatientCount) * 100.0) / InPatientCount
            ELSE 0
        END AS PercentageDeviation
    FROM Counts
)
SELECT MoreGroup, ROUND(PercentageDeviation, 2) AS PercentageDeviation
FROM Comparison;

WITH MaleCounts AS (
    SELECT
        Admission,
        COUNT(*) AS Count
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'Male'
    GROUP BY Admission
),
Totals AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT Count FROM MaleCounts WHERE Admission = '+') AS InPatientCount,
        (SELECT Count FROM MaleCounts WHERE Admission = '-') AS OutPatientCount
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN InPatientCount > OutPatientCount THEN 'In-patient'
        WHEN OutPatientCount > InPatientCount THEN 'Outpatient'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS MoreGroup,
    CASE
        WHEN InPatientCount IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN OutPatientCount IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN InPatientCount = OutPatientCount THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(ABS(InPatientCount - OutPatientCount) * 100.0 / ((InPatientCount + OutPatientCount) / 2), 2)
    END AS PercentageDeviation
FROM Totals;

WITH MalePatients AS (
    SELECT ID, Admission
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M'
),
Counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS InPatientCount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OutPatientCount
    FROM MalePatients
),
Result AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN InPatientCount > OutPatientCount THEN 'In-patient'
            WHEN OutPatientCount > InPatientCount THEN 'Out-patient'
            ELSE 'Equal'
        END AS MoreGroup,
        InPatientCount,
        OutPatientCount,
        CASE
            WHEN InPatientCount = OutPatientCount THEN 0
            ELSE ABS(InPatientCount - OutPatientCount) * 100.0 / ((InPatientCount + OutPatientCount) / 2.0)
        END AS DeviationPercentage
    FROM Counts
)
SELECT MoreGroup, ROUND(DeviationPercentage, 2) AS DeviationPercentage FROM Result;

WITH MaleCounts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS InPatientCount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OutPatientCount
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M'

SELECT

        WHEN InPatientCount > OutPatientCount THEN 'More in-patient males'
        WHEN InPatientCount < OutPatientCount THEN 'More outpatient males'
        ELSE 'Equal number of in-patient and outpatient males'
    END AS Comparison,
    CASE
        WHEN OutPatientCount = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(ABS(InPatientCount - OutPatientCount) * 100.0 / OutPatientCount, 2)
    END AS PercentageDeviation
FROM MaleCounts;

WITH AgeCalc AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        SEX,
        (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - 
        (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday)) AS Age
    FROM Patient
),
AbnormalPT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.ID
    FROM AgeCalc p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.Age > 55
      AND l.PT IS NOT NULL
      AND (l.PT < 11.0 OR l.PT > 13.5)
),
FemaleOver55 AS (
    SELECT ID FROM AgeCalc WHERE Age > 55 AND SEX = 'Female'
),
FemaleAbnormalPT AS (
    SELECT ID FROM AbnormalPT WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM FemaleOver55)
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FemaleOver55) = 0 THEN 0.0
         ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FemaleAbnormalPT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FemaleOver55), 2)
    END AS Percentage_Female_Abnormal_PT_Over_55
;

WITH AgeFiltered AS (
    SELECT 
        P.ID,
        P.SEX,
        L.PT,
        (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', P.Birthday)) AS Age
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
    WHERE Age > 55
),
FemalePatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM AgeFiltered
    WHERE SEX = 'Female'
),
FemaleAbnormalPT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM AgeFiltered
    WHERE SEX = 'Female' AND (PT IS NULL OR PT NOT BETWEEN 11 AND 13.5)
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN COUNT(FP.ID) = 0 THEN 0.0
         ELSE ROUND(CAST(COUNT(FAP.ID) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / COUNT(FP.ID), 2)
    END AS Percentage_Female_Abnormal_PT
FROM FemalePatients FP
LEFT JOIN FemaleAbnormalPT FAP ON FP.ID = FAP.ID;

WITH AgeCalc AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        SEX,
        (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - 
        (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday)) AS Age
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Birthday IS NOT NULL
),
AbnormalPT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory L
    JOIN AgeCalc A ON L.ID = A.ID
    WHERE A.Age > 55
      AND A.SEX = 'F'
      AND L.PT IS NOT NULL
      AND L.PT >= 14
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0.0
         ELSE 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AbnormalPT) / COUNT(*)
    END AS Percentage_Female_Abnormal_PT_Over_55
FROM AgeCalc
WHERE Age > 55 AND SEX = 'F';

WITH spent_per_year AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', e.event_date) AS year,
        SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.event_name = 'Student_Club' AND year IN ('2019', '2020')
    GROUP BY year
)

    COALESCE((SELECT total_spent FROM spent_per_year WHERE year = '2020'), 0) AS difference
;

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(exp.cost) AS total_cost
    FROM budget b
    LEFT JOIN expense exp ON b.budget_id = exp.link_to_budget
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
) cost_sum ON e.event_id = cost_sum.link_to_event
WHERE e.status = 'closed'
ORDER BY (IFNULL(cost_sum.total_cost, 0) - b.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT

FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(COALESCE(e.cost, 0)) AS total_cost,
        SUM(COALESCE(CASE WHEN ev.type = 'meeting' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS meeting_cost
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
) sub;

WITH state_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        z.state,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM member m
    JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
    WHERE z.state IN ('New Jersey', 'Vermont')
    GROUP BY z.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS total FROM member
),
percentages AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        (member_count * 100.0) / (SELECT total FROM total_members) AS percentage
    FROM state_counts
)
SELECT 
    ABS(
        (SELECT percentage FROM percentages WHERE state = 'New Jersey') -
        (SELECT percentage FROM percentages WHERE state = 'Vermont')
    ) AS difference_percentage;

WITH total_members AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM member
),
state_members AS (
    SELECT z.state, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM member m
    JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
    WHERE z.state IN ('New Jersey', 'Vermont')
    GROUP BY z.state
),
percentages AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        100.0 * count / (SELECT total FROM total_members) AS percentage
    FROM state_members
)
SELECT 
    ABS(
        (SELECT percentage FROM percentages WHERE state = 'New Jersey') -
        (SELECT percentage FROM percentages WHERE state = 'Vermont')
    ) AS difference_percentage;

WITH consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_2012
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2012' AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_2013
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2013' AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
percentage_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        c2012.Segment,
        c2012.total_2012,
        c2013.total_2013,
        CASE 
            WHEN c2012.total_2012 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((c2013.total_2013 - c2012.total_2012) * 100.0 / c2012.total_2012)
        END AS pct_change
    FROM consumption_2012 c2012
    JOIN consumption_2013 c2013 ON c2012.Segment = c2013.Segment
    WHERE c2012.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT Segment || ' (' || ROUND(pct_change,2) || '%)' FROM percentage_changes ORDER BY pct_change DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_segment,
    (SELECT Segment || ' (' || ROUND(pct_change,2) || '%)' FROM percentage_changes ORDER BY pct_change ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment;

WITH
consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption_2012
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date LIKE '2012%'
      AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date LIKE '2013%'
      AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
percentage_changes AS (
    SELECT
        c2012.Segment,
        c2012.total_consumption_2012,
        c2013.total_consumption_2013,
        CASE
            WHEN c2012.total_consumption_2012 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((c2013.total_consumption_2013 - c2012.total_consumption_2012) * 100.0) / c2012.total_consumption_2012
        END AS pct_change
    FROM consumption_2012 c2012
    JOIN consumption_2013 c2013 ON c2012.Segment = c2013.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM percentage_changes ORDER BY pct_change DESC LIMIT 1) AS segment_biggest_increase,
    (SELECT pct_change FROM percentage_changes ORDER BY pct_change DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_pct,
    (SELECT Segment FROM percentage_changes ORDER BY pct_change ASC LIMIT 1) AS segment_lowest_increase,
    (SELECT pct_change FROM percentage_changes ORDER BY pct_change ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_pct

WITH
-- Extract consumption per segment and year
consumption_per_segment_year AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, Year
),
-- Pivot consumption for 2012 and 2013 per segment
pivot_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption END) AS Consumption_2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption END) AS Consumption_2013
    FROM consumption_per_segment_year
    GROUP BY Segment
),
-- Calculate percentage increase per segment
percentage_increase AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        Consumption_2012,
        Consumption_2013,
        CASE
            WHEN Consumption_2012 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((Consumption_2013 - Consumption_2012) / ABS(Consumption_2012)) * 100
        END AS PercentIncrease
    FROM pivot_consumption
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM percentage_increase ORDER BY PercentIncrease DESC LIMIT 1) AS SegmentWithBiggestIncrease,
    (SELECT PercentIncrease FROM percentage_increase ORDER BY PercentIncrease DESC LIMIT 1) AS BiggestIncreasePercent,
    (SELECT Segment FROM percentage_increase ORDER BY PercentIncrease ASC LIMIT 1) AS SegmentWithLowestIncrease,
    (SELECT PercentIncrease FROM percentage_increase ORDER BY PercentIncrease ASC LIMIT 1) AS LowestIncreasePercent
;

WITH consumption_diff AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
percentage_increase AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        consumption_2013 - consumption_2012 AS increase,
        CASE 
            WHEN consumption_2013 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / consumption_2013) * 100
        END AS percentage_increase
    FROM consumption_diff
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM percentage_increase ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS segment_with_biggest_increase,
    (SELECT percentage_increase FROM percentage_increase ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_percentage_increase,
    (SELECT Segment FROM percentage_increase ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS segment_with_lowest_increase,
    (SELECT percentage_increase FROM percentage_increase ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_percentage_increase
;
